# Sudirman — Beyond the Ordinary

Canonical website: https://sudirman.eu.org/

## About
Sudirman is an Indonesian independent builder interested in technology, digital systems, automation, self-directed business, and practical ideas that can become useful projects.

## Topics
- Artificial intelligence and personal AI systems
- Digital systems and automation
- Web development and technology
- Independent projects and experiments
- Practical business ideas
- Personal notes and long-term projects

## Website
The homepage is the primary source for current information about Sudirman and his projects.
